name: 20 vs. 30-Year Mortgage Calculator
meta_description: Compare a 20-year and a 30-year mortgage when the lower payment is invested. See net worth year by year and the return where both plans break even.
subtitle: Find out whether paying off a home in 20 years beats taking 30 years and investing the lower payment. It tracks both loans and both investment pots year by year and shows which plan leaves you richer.
